reasoning: This is the standard AirPlay / wireless screen mirroring symbol (a screen outline with an upward triangle entering from the bottom). It fits tasks about wireless casting, AirPlay setup, or screen sharing, and can secondarily stand in for a TV or monitor, though users unfamiliar with Apple's icon may just read it as a monitor on a triangular stand.
